image.alt: On Tour original BoardGameTables.com box, USA and Europe

fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: The successor publisher’s official On Tour product page https://allplay.com/board-games/on-tour-usa-europe/ retains this original box image in its gallery. The BoardGameTables.com logo is visible on the box spine and confirms the printing named by the February 2019 rulebook. Reduced to 248 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The person with the best music taste rolls the dice first.
clarifications: That player handles the first card reveal and dice roll; all players write the resulting numbers on their maps simultaneously.
After everyone writes, pass the dice to the next person.
internalEvidence: Downloaded and rendered the BoardGameTables.com English rules from an archived copy. Page 2 names the best-music-taste first roller and states that everyone writes simultaneously; page 3 passes the dice after each turn. The source is the On Tour map game BGG 251412.
